meta.notes: get('sharpe_div_beta_12m'). Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}} (pydantic: "errors" instead of "message"). Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}; pandas frames add index and write NA/NaN/NaT as null. Prices: close is adjusted, close_raw is the exchange print (house rule 6). Regenerate with `.venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_ranking.py` from decile-blueprint.

output.definition: The 1-year sharpe return divided by beta, NULL when beta <= 0 (docs/05 §7).
output.label: SHARPE RETURN 1 YEAR / BETA
output.sql_expr: CASE WHEN beta_12m > 0 THEN sharpe_12m / beta_12m END
